extermination.name: Extermination
extermination.desc: Eliminate 500 runaway dinosaurs across all runs.

apex_hunter.name: Apex Hunter
apex_hunter.desc: Eliminate 2,500 runaway dinosaurs across all runs.

full_arsenal.name: Full Arsenal
full_arsenal.desc: Build all six tower types in a single mission.
full_arsenal.hint: Pulse + Chain + Cryo + Mortar + Flame + Hive.

fully_armed.name: Fully Armed
fully_armed.desc: Fully upgrade both branches of a single tower.

architect.name: Architect
architect.desc: Deploy ten towers in a single mission.

flawless.name: Flawless
flawless.desc: Win a mission without losing a single life.

triple_star.name: Triple Star
triple_star.desc: Earn a three-star rating on any mission.

full_spectrum.name: Full Spectrum
full_spectrum.desc: Face every enemy species and build every tower type in one mission.

master_engineer.name: Master Engineer
master_engineer.desc: Have one of every tower type fully upgraded at once.
master_engineer.hint: Six towers, each tier 3 on both branches.

perfect_run.name: Perfect Run
perfect_run.desc: Earn three stars on every mission.

full_service.name: Full Service
full_service.desc: Have every tower on the map serviced by a Hive drone.
full_service.hint: Every non-hive tower needs at least one drone assigned.

matriarch_stego.name: Plates Cracked
matriarch_stego.hint: Bring down the armored grazer queen.

matriarch_allosaur.name: Apex Predator Felled
matriarch_allosaur.hint: Bring down the largest hunter queen.

robot_ascendant.name: Ascendant Pilot
robot_ascendant.desc: Max out a single robot's skill tree.
robot_ascendant.hint: Every node on one robot at top rank.

robot_legion.name: Robot Legion
robot_legion.desc: Max out the skill tree of every robot.

lab_specialist.name: Lab Specialist
lab_specialist.desc: Fully upgrade a single tower in the lab.
lab_specialist.hint: All three meta branches maxed on one tower.

lab_overlord.name: Lab Overlord
lab_overlord.desc: Fully upgrade every tower in the lab.
lab_overlord.hint: All three meta branches maxed on all six towers.

endless_survivor.name: Endless Survivor
endless_survivor.desc: Reach wave 20 in an Endless arena.

heroic_effort.name: Heroic Effort
heroic_effort.desc: Clear any mission on Breach mode.

iron_will.name: Iron Will
iron_will.desc: Clear any mission on Containment mode.

mass_production.name: Mass Production
mass_production.desc: Field the maximum of a single tower type in one mission.

tree_hugger.name: Tree Hugger
tree_hugger.desc: Click the same tree ten times.
tree_hugger.hint: Some trees are hiding more than shade.

diamond_in_the_rough.name: Diamond in the Rough
diamond_in_the_rough.desc: Click the same rock ten times.

whispering_skull.name: Whispering Skull
whispering_skull.desc: Disturb the skull of the fallen.
whispering_skull.hint: The dead have things to say.

mushroom_puff.name: Mushroom Puff
mushroom_puff.hint: Some fungi don't like being poked.

barrel_roll.name: Barrel Roll
barrel_roll.hint: Not every barrel is staying put.

cabin_smoke.name: Home Fires
cabin_smoke.desc: Make smoke rise from a snow cabin.

crystal_shatter.name: Crystal Shatter
crystal_shatter.hint: Crystals break on the fifth tap.

cactus_bloom.name: Cactus Bloom
cactus_bloom.desc: Coax a desert plant to flower.
cactus_bloom.hint: Even cacti have a soft side.

ancient_glyph.name: Ancient Glyph
ancient_glyph.desc: Uncover the meaning of carved stone.
ancient_glyph.hint: Worn markings light up under touch.

fairy_ring.name: Fairy Ring
fairy_ring.desc: Disturb a wild ring of blooms.

baby_raptor.name: Baby Raptor
baby_raptor.desc: Find a hatchling hiding in the forest.
baby_raptor.hint: Small things hide among the trees.

snowman.name: Lone Snowman
snowman.desc: Find the last snowman in the snow.

ghost_trike.name: Phantom Trike
ghost_trike.desc: Catch a translucent Triceratops passing by.
ghost_trike.hint: Not all the dead stayed dead.

haunted_ruins.name: Haunted Ruins
haunted_ruins.desc: Wake the spirits of the wasteland.
